reference: Independent corpus written from SPEC rpv-embrittlement-pts rev 2026-10-17.5 (model 2026-10-11.rp-4) and the text of 10 CFR 50.61 / 50.61a (Tables 1-2 of 50.61 and Tables 1-7 of 50.61a transcribed from eCFR and GovInfo by transcribe_tables.py); expected values by ref_impl.py, recomputed by verify.py with Fraction/mpmath arithmetic (Student t quantile for n > 15 by mpmath incomplete beta).

tolerance: SPEC §10: expected is a partial copy of the outputs; objects compared over the keys given, arrays element by element with equal length, numbers |a - e| <= 1e-9*|e| (purely relative; an expected 0 requires exactly 0), everything else exactly. Cases with restore_replaces: true omit warnings (restored_values is not part of the corpus).
not_benchmarked: Fingerprint hash of §9 (approve: true stands for a matching fingerprint).
restored_values warning content (§10) and the warnings of cases marked restore_replaces.
Conversion of JSON objects / arrays in text fields (A-12).
Number text with a signed exponent such as "1e-5" (A-04).
path / vocabulary values given as non-strings (A-15).
adjacent naming a row with an invalid role or the id of an ignored duplicate row (B-04).
surveillance_data with empty parts, a trailing separator, CR LF line ends or white space before / after a whole point (C-01).
The se(m) = 0 branch of the slope test (C-12: exactly collinear residuals cannot be built from the transcendental dT30 predictions).
Exact density = limit boundaries other than 1.00 per 1000 in and 0.01 per 1000 in2 (C-17).
Exact 50.61a RT = limit boundaries (only near-boundary wall thickness columns are benchmarked).

Decision fingerprint content (whether a missing component flux key and an explicit null give the same fingerprint, R4-11); only approve: true with row flux present (r4-28) and a non-matching stored fingerprint (r4-29) are benchmarked.
UI, PDF, languages, presets content, Learn mode, project package and calculation record.
